profile.name: Joey van der Poel
profile.role: Full-Stack Mobile App Developer & AI Automation Engineer
profile.availability: Available for freelance contracts & small business builds

services.title: End-to-End Mobile App MVP
services.description: I design and code performant iOS and Android apps using React Native. From structural state logic to App Store and Google Play publication.

services.title: Business Process & Document Automation
services.description: I connect your documents, spreadsheets, and mainframe tools with custom AI extraction pipelines, eliminating hours of manual typing.

services.title: AI Feature Integration
services.description: Add intelligence to existing software. I integrate large language models, custom image classification APIs, and conversational assistance.

projects.title: Tracks & Taps (iOS App)
projects.tagline: Gamified travel & city exploration mobile SaaS published to the Apple App Store.
projects.highlights: ["Live interactive quest system & navigation logic","Pub Golf group exploration mode","Dynamic typography & text scaling accessibility features","Robust offline-first synchronization engine"]

projects.title: Mainframe Pricelist RPA (Tata Steel)
projects.tagline: Autonomous RPA pipeline typing supplier price grids directly into legacy mainframe screens.
projects.highlights: ["Replaced a manual entry process that previously required 2 full-time employees typing for 2 weeks straight","Engineered a highly resilient, exception-resistant robot optimized to run autonomously overnight","Handled dozens of legacy screen transition states and validation errors with zero mismatches","Automated price catalog synchronization directly into heritage mainframe databases"]

projects.title: Intelligent Document & RPA Pipeline (Tata Steel)
projects.tagline: Enterprise document extraction and order entry automation system.
projects.highlights: ["Replaced manual pricing and mainframe data entry logs","Substantially reduced line-item mismatches","Cut manual processing overhead by 90% across the department"]

projects.title: AI Zoo Guide Chatbot (DEPT®)
projects.tagline: Chatbot and animal recognition app to help zoo visitors (conceptual, not official Artis app).
projects.highlights: ["Trained custom Python CNN model for on-device animal species recognition","Integrated ChatGPT chatbot using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and prompt engineering","Built native Android Kotlin interface to assist visitors with conceptual zoo maps"]

projects.title: SwapClub Marketplace App
projects.tagline: Cross-platform circular economy marketplace app built with strict type safety.
projects.highlights: ["Modular layered codebase decoupling business logic from UI elements","Dynamic multi-tag catalog filtering pipelines","Optimized image uploading and compression assets"]

testimonials.quote: Joey took real ownership without needing much direction. Communication was clear and practical, deadlines were consistently met, and he brought a steady, solution-focused energy.
testimonials.author: Megan de Klein

testimonials.quote: Joey pushed the boundaries of the assignment by integrating AI features such as a chatbot and a custom image recognition model. He approached the stack with curiosity and depth.
testimonials.author: Ramon Nagelhout

testimonials.quote: Highly eager to learn, quickly grasps new concepts and consistently takes a solution-oriented approach. His application of AI within our workflows proved particularly valuable.
testimonials.author: Sarah Otto
